summary: AAP is sold as an annual subscription at Standard (8x5 support) or Premium (24x7 support, mission-critical) levels; both include maintenance, upgrades and all component updates.
questions: What is the difference between AAP Standard and Premium?
Are upgrades included in an AAP subscription?

answer_card.title: AAP subscription types
answer_card.answer_md:
| | Standard | Premium |
|---|---|---|
| Environment size | Any | Any, incl. mission-critical |
| Support | 8x5 | 24x7 |
| Maintenance and upgrades | Included | Included |
